record.paper: Coloring tournaments: from local to global

dossier_meta.paper: Coloring tournaments: from local to global
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every integer $i \geq 1$, there exists $f(i)$ such that every tournament $T$ with dominating number at least $f(i)$ contains an isomorphic copy of $S_i$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The tournaments $S_i$ are defined recursively: $S_1$ is a single vertex, and for $i > 1$, $S_i$ is the tournament on $2^i - 1$ vertices obtained by blowing up two vertices of an oriented triangle into two copies of $S_{i-1}$; one can check $\vec{\chi}(S_i) \geq i$. The problem is trivial for $i \leq 2$, verified for $i = 3$ in [7], and open for all $i \geq 4$.
